newsitem.title: UK: Fannie Mae says stg bond to be swapped into dlrs.
newsitem.headline: Fannie Mae says stg bond to be swapped into dlrs.

text.p: Fannie Mae treasurer Linda Knight told Reuters on Wednesday the 1.0 billion stg June 2002 global bond would be swapped into dollars.
"It has to be swapped into dollars. We are a dollar-based funder exclusively so any time we do anything in another currency it absolutely must be swapped back to dollars," Knight said.

"Sterling worked as both the original market and the swap market were there for us and we saw tremendous interest from U.K money managers, banks and building societies so we had the investor component as well," Knight said.
She said the first-ever sterling-denominated global bond was a success as it is the first time any entity was able to do such a transaction.
She said the driving force behind the success of the deal was Fannie Mae's triple-A credit quality, its strong financial condition and the good base of knowledge investors had of its paper.
Knight said the maturity of the deal was driven by the markets, by investor interest and by the swap markets.
"We are quite aware of EMU and the countries that may or may not be in or out, but it was really an economically-driven transaction," she said.
